peoples_entry.name: Hazmat Delvers, Cryo-Sleepers & Civic Trades
peoples_entry.note: Cross-cutting environmental survival gear, vault sleepers, and universal settlement trades: 0.48-atm hypobaric pass rebreathers, Valley Faraday/lead-glass delvers, pH-2.5 fumarole acid suits, Blade biogel-quarantine plague physicians, Tethis 12-bolt copper hard-hat divers, thawed cryo-vault sleepers, and seven universal civic trade overlays (blacksmith, butcher-tanner, baker-brewer, innkeeper, stevedore, chirurgeon, and ossuary undertaker).
